column1: scope\tVisible controls can be completed without changing the data model\tReuse existing listing, saved-search, saved-listing, profile, application, and chat flows; keep applicant demo state local\tBackend mutations and routes already cover persistent user-owned flows\taccepted

explore\tSaving, applying, and sorting are the only incomplete explore actions\tWire hearts and saved searches to Convex, route applications through the existing real application flow, and make sort selectable\tLive browser verified saved-home persistence after reload, rent sorting, saved-search persistence, and the real application profile gate\taccepted

profile\tProfile and agent management can reuse existing persistent screens and saved-search records\tRoute profile/settings to existing screens and persist new search agents through savedSearches.save\tLive browser verified agent edit persistence, profile editing, host dashboard, applications, and notification feedback\taccepted

listing\tThe compact handoff screen can publish through the existing listing mutations\tKeep its visual structure, turn fields and photos into inputs, and submit the required draft sections\tLive browser verified editable seeded fields, photo selection, and validation; existing backend listing tests passed\taccepted

applicants\tThe private-note button needs local state because no note API exists\tAdd a note sheet keyed by applicant while preserving the prototype swipe deck\tLive browser verified note save/reopen, pass, shortlist, match, navigation, and message send\taccepted

motion\tShared sheets must release the interface after their exit animation\tKeep the coordinated fade/pop animation and add a timed unmount fallback\tLive browser found and reproduced a lingering invisible modal; follow-up run showed it unmounted after exit\taccepted

verification\tThe feature wiring is complete when no explicit no-op remains and both static and runtime checks pass\tRun typecheck, lint, diff check, existing tests, and live control walkthrough\tTypeScript, ESLint, git diff check, 30 Vitest tests, and browser walkthrough passed\taccepted
